'''Verdisteel''' was a type of material used to build tubs. The [[Sidi Driss Inn]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] had [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-sized tubs with burnished verdisteel fixtures.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
